description: Frontend Web Developer with hands-on experience modernizing legacy web platforms and improving accessibility. Proven track record of migrating static architectures to dynamic database-driven systems and engineering custom frontend components that elevate user engagement and streamline content workflows.

Apply in-demand technologies like Python, SQL, Pandas, scikit-learn, and Hugging Face as well as industry best practices for exploratory data analysis (EDA), feature engineering, statistical analysis, data visualization, LLMs, RAGs, vector databases, and generative AI applications.
